posts.description: The Capture I finished watching The Capture , season 2 recently. (It’s free to watch on iView if you’re in Australia). Without spoiling too much, it’s a fantastic UK conspiracy/cop/spy thriller about weaponised deepfakes and their effect on society—particularly the justice system.
